definitions.explanation: Describing someone, especially a child, who is quick-witted and sharp in understanding. Carries a positive, somewhat literary nuance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{利発|りはつ}で、⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{理解|りかい}する→理解する：06059_rikaisuru⟧。
examples.english: He is clever and understands everything quickly.

examples.japanese: {利発|りはつ}そうな⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{少女|しょうじょ}→少女：03233_shoujo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んでいた→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: A girl with bright-looking eyes was reading a book.

notes: Often used to describe children or young people who show intelligence beyond their age. Has a literary or somewhat old-fashioned tone compared to more casual alternatives. Common patterns: {利発|りはつ}な⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (a clever child), {利発|りはつ}そうな (looking clever/bright). Related: ⟦{賢|かしこ}い→賢い：00192_kashikoi⟧ (smart, clever — more general and common), ⟦{聡明|そうめい}→聡明：28251_soumei⟧ (wise, intelligent — formal), ⟦{頭|あたま}がいい→頭がいい：20316_atamagaii⟧ (smart — casual).
